feeding_claim.verbatim: We are committed to raising our livestock on pasture and feeding only certified organic and non-GMO grain.

farmers_markets: Keene Valley Farmers Market, Marcy Field (Sundays)
Saranac Lake Farmers Market, Riverside Park (Saturdays)

local_areas: within about 100 miles of the farm

resold_note: Also sells 100% grass-fed beef from Asgaard Farm and Snug Valley Farm, and grass-fed lamb from Kinderhook Farm, Barred Owl Brook Farm and Essex Farm.
notes: Small farm in the Reber Valley at Essex, in the Adirondacks, run by Racey and Nathan Henderson since 2013. Checked the homepage, about page, product lineup page, grass-fed beef store page and home delivery page. The farm raises its own pasture-raised chicken, turkeys and pork, fed certified organic grain; the about page says the chicken and pigs are raised at Reber Rock while all beef and lamb come from partner farms, so beef and lamb are left out of species and put in resold_note (the store's quarter and eighth beef boxes are partner beef, so bulk_shares is false). Self-serve farm store open 24/7, online preorder for pickup, local delivery within about 100 miles, and UPS shipping. The homepage lists delivery to the Adirondacks, NY, VT, NH, ME, MA, CT, NJ, RI, DE and Eastern PA; the home delivery page shows the ground area only as a map image and offers express shipping beyond it, so the Verifier may check whether shipping is wider. Other pickup locations exist but are on a page not read. Farmers markets at Keene Valley and Saranac Lake per the homepage. No phone found. The site says the chicken is certified organic; left to the organic match script. Maple syrup is also sold.
